description: Routes métropolitaines encadrées de fossés et entretenus par la MEL is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Métropole Européenne de Lille. This data allows to visualize the metropolitan roads framed by ditches. The census of the ditches maintained by the MEL was carried out in September 2024 in order to better specify this heritage. This data is currently being stabilised. Coverage: Métropole Européenne de Lille. The portal shows the English title as "Metropolitan roads framed by ditches and maintained by the MEL" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Métropole Européenne de Lille. Its keywords include metropole-europeenne-de-lille, assainissement-eau-hydrographie, patrimoine, inspire, reseau-hydrographique, fosse. The listing shows 2 download or service links in OGC:WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
